the term “pro-life” is shorthand for “proponent of the right to life.”

I believe all elective abortion should be abolished, and medically necessary abortions should only be performed after all other non-abortive alternatives have been exhausted… but I’m also a pragmatist, so I would support partial abortion bans, and laws that do not criminalize the mothers. I understand the incoherence, but I would support an imperfect “pro-life” bill that has a chance of passing into law, than a perfect abolitionist bill that has no such chance… and then continue the fight in the political and cultural realms to make full abolition a actual possibility.
